summary: Allied Gold Corp filed a Form 6-K confirming normal course business and updating the regulatory approval process for its arrangement with Zijin Gold International Company Limited, announced January 26, 2026. The transaction involves Zijin Gold acquiring Allied Gold under an arrangement agreement. Specific terms such as price per share, premium, and implied value are not disclosed in this filing. The board is not stated to have provided a new recommendation. The outside closing date is May 29, 2026, subject to extension. This is a foreign private issuer report equivalent to a US Form 8-K. What to watch: regulatory approvals in Mali and completion timeline.
